info.name: CONSTRUPRECO API
info.description:
Single collection: Auth + Dashboard.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

Folder layout:
- Dashboard → Supplier → Inventory | Products | Promo Codes
- Dashboard → Factory → Products
- Dashboard → Admin

1) Auth → Login Supplier / Factory
2) Use matching Dashboard folder

request.description: Customer (user) email/password login.
Seeded via `pnpm seed:admin`. Default password from .env ADMIN_PASSWORD.
Customer signup. Returns requiresEmailVerification=true and sends OTP email (console if SMTP empty). Then call Auth/OTP/Verify before Login. Google/Facebook skips OTP.
Multipart form — documents optional for smoke test; required fields: companyName, email, phone, iban, password.
Public admin signup is DISABLED. Use `pnpm seed:admin` instead. This request is expected to fail with ValidationError.
5-digit OTP after customer/company email register (not Google/Facebook). Check email or server console if SMTP falls back.
Sends a 5-digit OTP to the email if an account exists. Same response whether or not the email is registered.
Validates the 5-digit reset OTP and returns a short-lived resetToken (10m). OTP is kept until reset-password.
Preferred after verify-reset-otp. Password min 8 chars.
Alternative: skip verify-reset-otp and send email + OTP + new password in one step.
Requires Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from Login. Token payload includes role.

item.name: CONSTRUPRECO (Website)
item.description:
Public storefront APIs for the CONSTRUPRECO website.

Products → Public | Customer | Company

Same endpoints; response changes by optional Bearer role.

request.description: All cart items + per-item promo/subtotal. fees = { shipping, vat, vatRate, currency } only — FE sums selected item.subtotal for Card Totals.
